name: DrawLesson
tagline: Step-by-step drawing lessons for beginners, plus an AI tool that turns your own reference image into a drawing tutorial.
description: DrawLesson helps beginners learn to draw one step at a time. It offers ready-made step-by-step lessons (animals, nature, people, anime, everyday objects), lets you draw on screen or trace on paper with your camera, and includes an AI tool that turns a reference image into a step sheet with written guidance. Basic practice is free: choosing a picture, ready-made lessons and drawing cost nothing. AI generations use credits (a paid Plus membership and credit packs are available), and generated steps should be reviewed before drawing.
